title: enrichment lib (langdetect npm + LLM country helper) + 单测
acceptance: src/lib/kol/enrichment.ts 实现 enrichKol(input): Promise<KolEnrichmentResult> 函数
language 推断: langdetect (或 franc) npm pkg + bio + displayName + handle 拼接输入; 置信度 >=0.5 才采纳, 否则返 null (不 fallback English 写错值)
country 推断: 优先 audience_geo_dist top-1 (>=40% 才采纳, source=audience-geo-top1); fallback LLM via runAigcAction (action_id from env AIGCGATEWAY_KOL_COUNTRY_ACTION_ID); LLM 置信度 >=0.5 才采纳
LLM 失败 (action_id missing / API error / 非 JSON 返回) → try/catch 内吞, country 返 null, 不向外 throw
package.json 加 dependency langdetect (或 franc, 同时纳入 lock file)

单元测试 src/lib/kol/__tests__/enrichment.test.ts >=6 case: 纯英文 bio → en / 日文 bio → ja / audience_geo_dist top-1=JP 60% → country=JP source=audience-geo-top1 / audience_geo_dist 空 + LLM mock 返 US 0.7 → country=US source=llm / 无任何材料 → country=null source=fallback-null / LLM mock throw → country=null (不 throw)
返回 { language, country, languageConfidence, countryConfidence, source: { language, country } } 结构

title: aigcgateway 创 kol-country-enrichment Action + env var 落 prod/staging
acceptance: aigcgateway 创 Action: name='kol-country-enrichment', model='claude-haiku-4.5', variables=[bio, display_name, platform, audience_geo], response_format JSON object
Prompt 模板: KOL audience analyst 推断 country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) from bio + audience_geo + platform; 输出 { country: <code> or null, confidence: 0-1 }; confidence <0.5 返 null
拿到 action_id (如 cmXXXXXXX) — 通过 mcp__aigc-gateway__create_action 或 KOLMatrix 控制台
SSH prod + staging 落 env var AIGCGATEWAY_KOL_COUNTRY_ACTION_ID=<cmXXXXXXX>; 备份 .env.{production,staging}.bl075-f002.YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS; pm2 reload --update-env
prod + staging /api/health 200 healthy 验证 reload 成功
.auto-memory/environment.md aigcgateway Actions 清单加 kol-country-enrichment entry (含 action_id, env var name, 单次成本估算 ~$0.0005, 用途说明)
手动 mcp__aigc-gateway__run_action 实测 1 次, 返回 valid JSON { country: 'US' or null, confidence: 0-1 }

title: kol-sync-daily.ts 加 enrichment 阶段 + audit_log
acceptance: scripts/kol-sync-daily.ts 在 sync stage 后加 enrichment stage
仅处理 NULL country_code OR NULL language OR 空字符串 的 KOL (避免重复)
调 enrichKol() lib, 拿 result 后 withTenant 内 prisma.kol.update + auditLog.create 同 transaction
audit_log: tenantId / action='kol.enriched' / resourceType='kol' / resourceId=kol.id / payload={before, after, source, confidence}
并发限制 5 个 LLM 调用 (p-limit 或类似), 避免 LLM rate limit
日志 (console.log) 记 enrichment count + LLM call count + 估算成本 (LLM count × $0.0005)
单元测试 mock LLM + Prisma >=3 case: 新 KOL enrichment / 老 NULL KOL 复跑 / LLM 失败 skip
staging 跑一次 daily sync 实测有 enrichment 发生 (audit_log 写入验证)

title: scripts/kol-enrichment-backfill.ts + 跑 1397 KOL 全量
acceptance: scripts/kol-enrichment-backfill.ts 实现支持 --dry-run + 实跑 + --tenant=<uuid> 限定
--dry-run 仅 print 不写 DB, 可重复跑确认逻辑
实跑: 用 withPlatformAdmin 拉跨 tenant NULL country_code OR language KOL, 调 enrichKol, withTenant 内 update + audit_log
并发 5, 进度 print (每 100 KOL)
最终报告: total / enriched language count / enriched country count / failed count / language_fill_rate / country_fill_rate / LLM call count / cost estimate
SSH prod 跑 (set -a; source .env.production; set +a; tsx scripts/kol-enrichment-backfill.ts) 实跑 1397 KOL 全量
抽样 20-30 KOL 人工 review accuracy (随机抽样, language / country 各 10-15) — best-effort 不设硬阈仅记实际数值
新建 docs/test-reports/BL-075-backfill-2026-05-XX.md 报告 (含 fill_rate / accuracy / LLM cost / 错误案例)
